description: The Grand Journey: the paper board (data/board-v0-paper.json) with the approved story (step I-4, grown-up voice) as 'story' and 'icon' per square and in 'story' for the rule elements. Every rule field is identical to the paper board; 'text' keeps the paper's original words.

5.story: Shoelace untied. Again. Wait one turn.

10.story: Wait… did you lock the door? Back home.

15.story: Ankle-deep puddle. Next turn: one careful step.

20.story: A farmer offers a lift. Don't overthink it.

25.story: Sheep have right of way. Wait one turn.

30.story: The Bog. Your shoes live here now. Roll a 6.

35.story: Hay cart to the forest. Not glamorous, but fast.

40.story: Hot-air balloon. See you at the river!

45.story: It's all downhill from here. Throw twice, add up.

50.story: Fog rolls in. The map app gives up. Wait three turns.

55.story: Forest Station. A train that's actually on time!

60.text: Bonus card: once, whenever you like - avoid one of your punishments OR cancel a reward of another player
60.story: A kind stranger slips you a Bonus card.

65.text: Go to nearest reward and do it
65.story: A local knows a shortcut: next good square!

70.text: Your flight is broken, go back to 55
70.story: Train cancelled. Of course. Back to Forest Station.

75.text: Change place with the player closest to END
75.story: Plot twist! Swap places with the leader.

80.story: Cable car to the Mountain Lodge. Window seat!

85.text: You won lottery, go to bank
85.story: Free boat ride to the Harbour. Best day ever.

90.story: Bog boots. Mud? Never heard of it.

95.story: Missed the river ferry by four minutes. Next one: "shortly". Wait one turn.

97.story: Riverbank selfie. Slipped. Straight into the Bog.

101.story: Missed the boat. Literally. Back to the Pier.

108.text: Get some vacation, go to hotel
108.story: Spontaneous weekend off. Straight to the Mountain Lodge.

113.story: Wrong turn. Back down into the fog, wait three turns.

118.story: Free ski lift. Every little helps.

123.story: Sledge run! Throw three times, add them all up.

128.text: Go to nearest punishment and do it
128.story: You trust the map app again. Next bad square.

133.story: Lodge booking? What booking? Back to Base Camp.

138.text: Follow the snake - become Snake Leader
138.story: A sea snake gives you a lift. Snake Leader!

143.text: The other players double what they throw
143.story: Ice cream break. Everyone else doubles their next throw.

148.story: Wrong ferry. All the way back to the Bog.

153.story: Waiting for the tide. Wait one turn.

155.text: Bonus card: once, whenever you like - avoid one of your punishments OR cancel a reward of another player
155.story: A kind stranger slips you a Bonus card.

158.story: Wrong snake. This one goes all the way back.

163.story: Green lights all the way. Throw again.

168.text: Invited to a party, go to 179
168.story: Friends saved you a spot at the Fair!

173.text: Got new car, go fast to work 184
173.story: Last e-scooter in town. Zoom to Central Station!

178.story: Forgot your Fair ticket. Go back for it.

183.text: Car was stolen, go to police 97 - no prison
183.story: Fell asleep on the train. Woke up at the river.

188.story: Missed your stop. Back to the seaside.

193.story: Forgot your keys! Back to Central Station.

198.text: Forgot keys again, back to work 184 and skip two turns
198.story: Forgot your keys AGAIN!!! Back to Central Station, wait two turns.

202.text: Snake Leader only: follow the snake back to 165
202.story: Snake Leader? The snake wants its ride back. Down you go.

rulesNote: rules = FROZEN set (14 Oct 2026, GCD R1-R21). rulesR1R16 = the earlier baseline, kept so older reports can be reproduced. R16 (enterAfter/trapAfter) is replaced by R17 waiting stairs.

start.name: Home
start.story: Bags packed. Roll a 6 to leave.

end.name: Festival of Lights
end.story: Festival of Lights! You made it. Light your lanterns!

start.name: Porch steps
start.story: No 6? Still on the porch. One more step.
start.picture: wooden steps beside the front door, one added per failed throw

trap.name: Stepping stones
trap.story: No 6? Another stone. The mud is patient.
trap.picture: stones in the mud from 30 towards 31, one added per failed throw

lifelines.name: Lanterns
lifelines.lose: Three throws, no 6. A lantern flickers out.
lifelines.win: Three 6s in a row. Lantern back on!
lifelines.none: Attention! You have no lanterns left…
lifelines.out: Lights out. Your journey ends here.

roadblock.name: Fallen tree
roadblock.story: Fallen tree. Nobody's moving it. Back ten squares.

safe.name: Main Road
safe.story: The Main Road. Boring, but it works.

bonus.name: Bonus card
bonus.story: Cancel a punishment for yourself, or a reward for another player. Once.

jailPass.name: Bog boots
jailPass.story: Bog boots. Mud? Never heard of it.

snakeLeader.name: Snake Leader
snakeLeader.story: Snake Leader: you rode the snake. It remembers.
